purpose.answer:
Repository documentation describes: A self-hosted company workspace with a consistent modern UI: writing, spreadsheets, presentations, files, PDF signing, chat, meetings, projects, timesheets, leave, company knowledge, mail and an accessible AI sidebar. **This is an independent, functional foundation, not a complete reimplementation of Microsoft 365, Adobe Acrobat, Jira or SharePoint.** It uses public formats and original application code. No proprietary binaries were supplied or decompiled. See the exact capability boundaries below before adopting it for production. New documents open in the original MIT Studio editors. Existing native documents offer **Create editable Studio copy**, preserving the original bytes and history. The independent PDF workspace adds annotations, page rotation/removal and existing form-field filling.
